name: Hi Auto
oneLiner: Israeli-founded voice AI company whose AI order taker answers the drive-thru speaker, takes the order into the POS and upsells, built specifically for noisy drive-thru lanes.
bestFor: Quick-service chains with high-volume drive-thrus that want automated, branded voice ordering across many stores.

updates.text: Bojangles extended its partnership for multiple years and plans to add Hi Auto voice AI to 100 more drive-thrus by mid-2027 (on top of about 500), adding upsells that adjust to drive-thru queue length.
Hi Auto said its system passed 100 million drive-thru orders a year across its customers.

features: AI order taking at the drive-thru speaker post
Noise handling tuned for drive-thru conditions
Order injection into the POS and kitchen display
Automated upselling, including suggestions based on queue length
Custom branded voice personas (for example Bojangles' 'Bo-Linda')
Pickup-window monitoring product (Window Intelligence), in beta with brands including Lee's
notes: Update dates: the Bojangles extension is recent Restaurant Dive coverage (exact month not confirmed, likely 2026); the 100M-orders milestone was reported in 2025 (per current review) via TechBullion. A $15M Series A in April 2025 appears only on secondary pages and was not used. Dropped from current review: '96% order accuracy and 90%+ completion' (vendor figures vary between sources: 93-98%). Burger King New Zealand and Popeyes UK are named as customers in press summaries but no primary source was checked. Bojangles is also adding Spanish ordering across drive-thru, kiosk and app.
